sentences.text: Misc .
Criminal Case No. 50956 of 2025

Dhaniram @ Raja Prajapati
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Aman Soni - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Anoop Sonkar - Dy. G.A. for the State.

Order 
This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.185/2021 registered at Police Station - Nishaatpura, District Bhopal(M.P.)
for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant has been arrested on 21.02.2021.
Previous bail application were dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3.
Learned Senior Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 21.02.2021 i.e. more than five and a half years and trial is still not completed.
It is submitted that six witnesses are yet to be examined.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:10113 2 MCRC-50956-2025 4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
Applicant is also directed not to threaten the prosecutrix and tamper the evidence during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.

7. If applicant is found in close vicinity of the prosecutrix or her family members then the prosecutrix will be free to report the matter in the concerned Police Station and seek cancellation of his bail.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
